abstract: The US Inflation Reduction Act’s Energy Communities provisions aimed to increase clean-energy investment in areas vulnerable to the energy transition, create jobs, and build political support for decarbonisation. This column combines data on renewable energy investment, job vacancies, and elections with survey evidence on public opinion to argue that the provisions successfully promoted solar investment, but generated little employment and did not shift political attitudes.
abstract_zh: 美国《通胀削减法案》中的“能源社区”条款旨在促进能源转型脆弱地区的清洁能源投资，创造就业机会，并为脱碳构建政治支持。本文结合可再生能源投资、职位空缺和选举数据，以及关于公众舆论的调查证据，论证这些条款成功推动了太阳能投资，但产生的就业效应有限，且未能改变政治态度。
authors: Joep Keuzenkamp, Jacopo Mazza, Bob Rijkers, Katherine Stapleton
title: The Inflation Reduction Act’s regional incentives promoted green investment, but did not create jobs
title_zh: 《通胀削减法案》的区域激励措施促进了绿色投资，但未创造就业

abstract: We study periodic review perishable inventory systems with a fixed product lifetime, positive replenishment lead times, and a general issuance policy under the average cost criterion. The optimal replenishment policy for such systems is notoriously complex and computationally intractable because of the curse of dimensionality. To address this challenge, we propose a class of projected inventory level (PIL) policies, which maintain a constant expected on-hand inventory level, and compare them with conventional base-stock (BS) policies that maintain a constant inventory position. For both backlogging and lost-sales systems, we show that the best PIL policy is asymptotically optimal with large unit penalty costs for a broad class of unbounded demand distributions. When demand is bounded and the unit penalty cost is sufficiently large, we prove that the best BS policy is optimal under first-in-first-out issuance, whereas the best PIL policy is optimal under last-in-first-out issuance (under certain conditions). Furthermore, we show that both policies are asymptotically optimal as the demand population size grows large, and their optimality gaps diminish exponentially fast in backlogging systems under a broad range of issuance policies. To facilitate computation, we introduce a class of approximate PIL (APIL) policies and extend most theoretical results for PIL to the APIL policy. Numerical results show that both PIL and APIL policies perform very close to optimal and significantly outperform BS policies. This paper was accepted by Jeannette Song, operations management. abstract_zh: 我们研究具有固定产品寿命、正补货提前期以及一般发放策略的周期性审查易腐品库存系统，在平均成本准则下进行探讨。此类系统的最优补货策略因维度灾难而著称，极为复杂且计算上难以处理。为应对这一挑战，我们提出了一类投影库存水平（PIL）策略，该策略维持恒定的预期现有库存水平，并将其与维持恒定库存位置的传统基准库存（BS）策略进行比较。对于缺货回补和销售损失两种系统，我们证明在广泛的无界需求分布类别中，最优PIL策略在大单位惩罚成本下具有渐近最优性。当需求有界且单位惩罚成本足够大时，我们证明在先进先出发放规则下最优BS策略为最优，而在后进先出发放规则下（在特定条件下）最优PIL策略为最优。此外，我们表明随着需求总体规模增大，两种策略均具有渐近最优性，且在缺货回补系统中，在广泛的发放策略下，其最优性差距以指数速度缩小。为便于计算，我们引入了一类近似PIL（APIL）策略，并将PIL的大部分理论结果扩展至APIL策略。数值结果表明，PIL和APIL策略的表现均非常接近最优，且显著优于BS策略。本文由Jeannette Song负责运营管理方向接受。资助：X. Gong和H. Yin部分受国家自然科学基金[批准号72425008]及香港研究资助局优配研究金[批准号CUHK14500120]资助。J. Bu部分受香港研究资助局优配研究金[批准号PolyU15504525]资助。补充材料：在线附录及数据文件可在https://doi.org/10.1287/mnsc.2023.03801获取。

abstract: The future architecture of financial systems is a subject of contention, with centralized and decentralized governance proponents. Here, we ask the following question. Would the architecture affect the quality of decision making? We propose a game where financial network participants demarcate the ownership of claims to income. This governance task can be decentralized (shared authority), centralized (single authority), or hybrid (alternating authority). Without communication, all architectures supported poor outcomes. With communication, decentralization ensured good governance and maximum profits, whereas centralization did not—lowering communication’s potency in promoting socially optimal decisions. This indicates that there is scope for decentralization in innovating financial institutions. This paper has been accepted by Camelia Kuhnen for the Virtual Special Issue on Digital Finance. Funding: N. Chemaya acknowledges partial financial support from the NET Institute. Supplemental Material: The online appendix and data files are available at https://doi.org/10.1287/mnsc.2025.02314 .
abstract_zh: 金融体系的未来架构是一个争议性话题，支持者分别主张集中治理与分散治理。在此，我们提出以下问题：架构是否会影响决策质量？我们构建了一个博弈模型，其中金融网络参与者界定对收入索取权的归属。这一治理任务可以采取分散化（共享权威）、集中化（单一权威）或混合型（交替权威）形式。在没有沟通的情况下，所有架构均导致不良结果。而在存在沟通时，分散化确保了良好治理并实现利润最大化，而集中化则未能如此——削弱了沟通在促进社会最优决策方面的效力。这表明，在金融制度创新中，分散化具有潜在空间。本文已被Camelia Kuhnen接受，收录于数字金融虚拟特刊。资助信息：N. Chemaya感谢NET研究所的部分财务支持。补充材料：在线附录及数据文件可在 https://doi.org/10.1287/mnsc.2025.02314 获取。
publisher: Institute for Operations Research and the Management Sciences (INFORMS)
title: Centralization vs. Decentralization: First Evidence from the Laboratory
title_zh: 集中化与分散化：来自实验室的首个证据

abstract: Firm-level data sets suffer from panel attrition, and it can also be a problem with dynamic panel estimates. In this paper, we explore the question of whether the leverage estimates of a firm are meaningfully impacted by a predictable exit event, after adjusting for firm and time characteristics. We use a cross-fitted machine-learning model to estimate survival probabilities for an unbalanced panel of firms from 1999 to 2024, using lagged financial characteristics. Predictions show almost perfect separation between the groups of firms that survive and the group of firms that exit, suggesting little common support. We build stabilized inverse probability weights and re-estimate dynamic leverage models with firm and year fixed-effects. The weighted estimates suggest there is less leverage persistence and more speed of adjustment to the target leverage than conventional fixed-effects estimates, and the core qualitative relationships are largely unchanged. Therefore, the direction of estimated leverage dynamics is not really affected by predictable attrition, as it is the magnitude that is affected. The weighted estimates are only interpreted as sensitivity evidence due to limited overlap; there are no globally identified causal effects. KEYWORDS: Attrition bias corporate leverage machine learning panel data selection adjustment JEL CLASSIFICATION: C23 C55 G32 Acknowledgements We would like to express our sincere appreciation to Professor Mark Taylor, the Editor, for his guidance and constructive feedback throughout the review process. We are also grateful to the two anonymous reviewers for their careful evaluation and insightful and constructive comments, which have substantially improved the quality, clarity, and rigour of our manuscript.
abstract_zh: 企业层面的数据集常面临面板 attrition（样本流失）问题，这一问题同样可能影响动态面板估计。本文探讨在调整企业与时间特征后，企业杠杆估计是否受到可预测退出事件的显著影响。我们采用交叉拟合机器学习模型，基于滞后财务特征，对1999年至2024年间非平衡面板企业样本的生存概率进行估计。预测结果显示，存活企业与退出企业群体之间几乎完全分离，表明共同支持域极为有限。我们构建了稳定化逆概率权重，并重新估计了包含企业与年份固定效应的动态杠杆模型。加权估计结果表明，相较于传统固定效应估计，杠杆持续性有所降低，而向目标杠杆调整的速度则加快，核心定性关系基本保持不变。因此，可预测 attrition 对估计的杠杆动态方向影响不大，主要影响的是其幅度。由于共同支持域有限，加权估计仅作为敏感性证据解读，不存在全局识别的因果效应。关键词：Attrition 偏差；企业杠杆；机器学习；面板数据；选择调整 JEL分类号：C23 C55 G32 致谢：我们衷心感谢编辑 Mark Taylor 教授在审稿过程中给予的指导与建设性反馈。同时，我们也感谢两位匿名审稿人的细致评估及深刻且富有建设性的意见，这些意见显著提升了我们稿件的质量、清晰度与严谨性。
title: When attrition is predictable: machine learning and the estimation of corporate leverage dynamics
title_zh: 当损耗可预测时：机器学习与企业杠杆动态的估计

abstract: Green poverty reduction, which integrates green development and poverty reduction, has become a vital foundation for long-term regional development. Given China’s role as the world’s largest emitter and its ongoing transition, the carbon emissions trading policy has a significant impact on regional environmental improvement and economic development. However, its effects on green poverty reduction in China remain underexplored. This study calculates the green poverty reduction index and investigates the influence of the carbon emissions trading policy on green poverty reduction by applying the difference-in-differences model using provincial data of China from 2006 to 2022. The results demonstrate that: (1) the carbon emissions trading policy significantly promotes regional green poverty reduction; (2) the heterogeneity analysis shows that this positive effect varies across allocation of carbon emission quotas modes, geographical locations and the degree of carbon trading market effectiveness; (3) the mechanism analysis identifies that improving green innovation efficiency and reducing fiscal decentralization are two critical channels through which carbon emissions trading policy to affects green poverty reduction. These findings provide empirical evidence for optimizing carbon market mechanisms to promote green poverty reduction more effectively, and offering practical insights for improving policy design and regional sustainable development strategies. KEYWORDS: Carbon emissions trading policy green poverty reduction difference-in-differences model green innovation efficiency fiscal decentralization JEL CLASSIFICATION: O44 O13 R11 Q48
abstract_zh: 绿色减贫融合了绿色发展理念与减贫目标，已成为区域长期发展的重要基石。鉴于中国作为全球最大碳排放国的地位及其正在进行的转型，碳排放交易政策对区域环境改善和经济发展具有重要影响。然而，其对我国绿色减贫的影响尚未得到充分探讨。本研究计算了绿色减贫指数，并运用双重差分模型，基于2006年至2022年中国省级面板数据，考察了碳排放交易政策对绿色减贫的影响。研究结果表明：（1）碳排放交易政策显著促进了区域绿色减贫；（2）异质性分析显示，这一积极效应因碳排放配额分配方式、地理位置及碳交易市场有效程度的不同而存在差异；（3）机制分析表明，提升绿色创新效率和降低财政分权程度是碳排放交易政策影响绿色减贫的两条重要渠道。这些发现为优化碳市场机制以更有效地促进绿色减贫提供了经验证据，并为完善政策设计和区域可持续发展战略提供了实践启示。关键词：碳排放交易政策；绿色减贫；双重差分模型；绿色创新效率；财政分权 JEL分类：O44 O13 R11 Q48

abstract: Green finance is an important policy tool for advancing green development in China, while new green-firm entry is an integral part of this transition. Using data from 278 Chinese prefecture-level cities from 2015 to 2023, this study measures the level of green finance development and examines its relationship with green entrepreneurial entry intensity. The empirical results show that green finance is significantly associated with higher green entrepreneurial entry intensity, and this finding remains robust across a series of robustness checks. The mechanism analysis suggests that green technological innovation and the external financing environment are two important channels linking green finance to green entrepreneurial entry. The heterogeneity analysis shows that this positive relationship is stronger in old industrial-base cities and in cities with stronger science and education endowments. The positive relationship also remains robust after accounting for spatial dependence across cities. This study provides empirical evidence on the role of green finance in new green-firm entry and offers useful implications for local governments seeking to develop more targeted green finance and entrepreneurship policies. KEYWORDS: Green finance green entrepreneurial entry intensity green technological innovation industrial legacy science and education endowments JEL CLASSIFICATION: G21 Q56 L26
abstract_zh: 绿色金融是推动中国绿色发展的重要政策工具，而新绿色企业的进入则是这一转型过程中不可或缺的组成部分。本研究利用2015年至2023年中国278个地级市的数据，测度了绿色金融发展水平，并考察了其与绿色创业进入强度之间的关系。实证结果表明，绿色金融与更高的绿色创业进入强度显著相关，且这一发现在一系列稳健性检验中依然成立。机制分析表明，绿色技术创新和外部融资环境是连接绿色金融与绿色创业进入的两个重要渠道。异质性分析显示，这一正向关系在旧工业基地城市以及科教资源较为丰富的城市中更为显著。在考虑城市间空间依赖性后，这一正向关系依然稳健。本研究为绿色金融在促进新绿色企业进入方面的作用提供了经验证据，并为地方政府制定更具针对性的绿色金融与创业政策提供了有益启示。关键词：绿色金融；绿色创业进入强度；绿色技术创新；工业遗产；科教资源；JEL分类：G21 Q56 L26

abstract: This editorial introduces the Special Issue, Sustainability Dialogue: Land Management Practices and Climate Change Resilience Efforts, developed from a Summer School and journal call involving scholars and practitioners across the global sustainability community. Its articles provide multidisciplinary teaching and reference material linking land governance, ecological processes, climate risk, technology, and human behaviour across rural, urban, forest, agricultural, and river-basin settings. Governance studies show that resilience requires coordinated institutions, secure land access, and incentives for long-term stewardship. At the same time, social research explains how local knowledge, livelihoods, adoption, public services, and environmental justice shape intervention outcomes. Ecological studies examine biodiversity, wetlands, forests, soils, ecosystem services, carbon storage, and fragmentation, identifying practical pathways such as agroforestry, conservation agriculture, green infrastructure, nature-based solutions, urban forestry, and restoration, alongside trade-offs involving production, urbanisation, energy, property values, and carbon sequestration. Remote sensing, GIS, modelling, artificial intelligence, and scenario tools support hazard mapping, attribution, forecasting, and intervention planning. Evidence from Africa, Asia, Europe, and the Americas links diagnosis, prediction, governance, finance, and implementation, advancing place-based, socially accountable, climate-resilient land management.
abstract_zh: 本社论介绍了特刊《可持续性对话：土地管理实践与气候变化韧性努力》，该特刊源于一次暑期学校及期刊征稿活动，汇聚了全球可持续性社群的学者与实践者。其文章提供了多学科的教学与参考材料，将土地治理、生态过程、气候风险、技术及人类行为联系起来，覆盖农村、城市、森林、农业及流域等多种环境。治理研究表明，韧性需要协调的制度、有保障的土地获取权以及促进长期管护的激励机制。同时，社会研究解释了地方知识、生计、采纳行为、公共服务及环境正义如何影响干预成果。生态研究考察了生物多样性、湿地、森林、土壤、生态系统服务、碳储存及破碎化，识别出农林业、保护性农业、绿色基础设施、基于自然的解决方案、城市林业及生态恢复等实践路径，并探讨了涉及生产、城市化、能源、房产价值及碳封存之间的权衡取舍。遥感、地理信息系统、建模、人工智能及情景工具支持灾害绘图、归因分析、预测及干预规划。来自非洲、亚洲、欧洲及美洲的证据将诊断、预测、治理、融资与实施相连接，推进了基于地方、对社会负责且具有气候韧性的土地管理。
title: Knowledge base on sustainability of land management practices and climate change resilience efforts
title_zh: 土地管理实践可持续性与气候变化韧性努力的知识基础

abstract: This study examines the health and welfare costs of construction-driven air pollution in a rapidly urbanizing context. We exploit the predictable, nationwide cessation of construction during China’s Spring Festival holiday, combined with cross-city variation in construction intensity, as a quasi-natural experiment identifying the causal effect of construction on air quality and mortality. Using city-level panel data from the China National Environmental Monitoring Centre matched with official construction statistics, we show that a 10,000-square-meter increase in annual construction area widens the Air Quality Index (AQI) gap between active-construction and holiday-shutdown periods by 0.772 points, raising annual respiratory and cardiovascular mortality rates by 0.173 and 0.737 per 100,000 inhabitants, respectively. These health costs fall disproportionately on women. We propose and test a gendered time–space exposure mechanism: socially structured differences in caregiving responsibilities and labor force participation increase women’s daytime exposure to localized construction pollution. Consistent with this mechanism, the female mortality effect is larger in cities with heavier childcare burdens and lower female labor force participation. We estimate annual welfare losses of $84.32 billion, equivalent to a gross health externality of $9.01 per square meter of annual construction. We interpret these estimates as pricing an urban-development externality, pointing to targeted mitigation through dust control, work scheduling, and residential-area protection.
abstract_zh: 本研究考察了快速城市化背景下建筑活动引发的空气污染所带来的健康与福利成本。我们利用中国春节期间全国范围内可预测的建筑停工现象，结合城市间建筑强度的差异，作为准自然实验，以识别建筑活动对空气质量及死亡率的因果效应。基于中国国家环境监测中心提供的城市层面面板数据，并与官方建筑统计数据相匹配，我们显示，年建筑面积每增加1万平方米，会使活跃施工期与假期停工期之间的空气质量指数（AQI）差距扩大0.772点，进而使年度呼吸系统及心血管疾病死亡率分别每10万人增加0.173例和0.737例。这些健康成本不成比例地落在女性群体上。我们提出并检验了一种性别化的时空暴露机制：由社会结构决定的照护责任与劳动力参与差异，增加了女性在日间对局部建筑污染的暴露。与该机制一致，女性死亡率效应在育儿负担较重及女性劳动力参与率较低的城市中更为显著。我们估算年度福利损失为843.2亿美元，相当于每平方米年建筑面积产生9.01美元的总体健康外部性。我们将这些估算解读为对城市发展外部性的定价，指向通过扬尘控制、工作调度及居住区域保护实施有针对性的减缓措施。

title: The price of progress: Causal evidence on the health, economic, and gendered costs of construction-driven air pollution
title_zh: 进步的代价：建筑驱动型空气污染对健康、经济及性别维度的因果证据

abstract: Community-oriented policing (COP) is one of the most widely touted mechanisms for building bridges between police forces and the communities they serve. But evidence on the effectiveness of COP is surprisingly scant. We present results from one of the first randomized controlled trials to evaluate the impact of COP in the Global South. The COP initiative we study was locally designed and funded by the Ugandan government. Contrary to our expectations, we find no evidence that the program reduced crime, enhanced citizens’ perceptions of safety, improved their attitudes towards the police, increased crime reporting, or strengthened other norms of citizen cooperation with the police. Nor do we find evidence that the program generated greater empathy or accountability among participating police officers themselves. We explore a variety of potential explanations for these null results, including both supply-side factors (e.g., resource constraints within the Ugandan police force) and demand-side factors (e.g., citizens’ fear of engaging with the police). We find no evidence that overcoming these obstacles would make COP more effective. Taken together, our findings point to potential limitations of COP in low-income countries.
abstract_zh: 社区导向警务（COP）是构建警察与所服务社区之间桥梁的最受推崇的机制之一。然而，关于COP有效性的证据却出奇地匮乏。我们展示了全球南方首批评估COP影响的随机对照试验之一的结果。我们研究的COP倡议由乌干达政府本地设计并资助。与我们的预期相反，我们发现没有证据表明该计划减少了犯罪、提升了公民的安全感、改善了他们对警察的态度、增加了犯罪举报，或加强了公民与警察合作的其他规范。我们同样未发现该计划增强了参与警察自身的同理心或问责制的证据。我们探讨了这些无效结果的各种潜在解释，包括供给侧因素（如乌干达警力内部的资源限制）和需求侧因素（如公民对与警察接触的恐惧）。我们没有发现克服这些障碍会使COP更有效的证据。综合来看，我们的研究结果指出了低收入国家中COP可能存在的局限性。
title: Can community policing improve police-community relations in a low-income country setting?
title_zh: 社区警务能否改善低收入国家环境下的警民关系？

abstract: We study how short-term political incentives affect firms’ compliance with environmental regulation. In China, city mayors face a sharp drop in promotion probability after age 57, creating a transitory enforcement window. Using a regression discontinuity design, we find that firms governed by promotion-eligible mayors reduce sulfur dioxide ( S O 2 ) emissions substantially more than under the same mayors after the threshold. These reductions are concentrated among firms without end-of-pipe abatement equipment and are driven by temporary cuts in operating hours and output rather than technological upgrades. We further document that government subsidies increase during the promotion window and are disproportionately directed to unequipped firms that curtail production, consistent with coordinated short-run compliance. A back-of-the-envelope calculation suggests that these transitory incentives account for 5.2% of the national S O 2 decline during the Eleventh Five-Year Plan, but at a cost of 0.9% of total industrial output. We develop a dynamic model of firm compliance showing that such short-lived incentives induce inefficient output-based responses. Our findings highlight the limits of episodic regulatory pressure.
abstract_zh: 我们研究了短期政治激励如何影响企业遵守环境法规的情况。在中国，城市市长在57岁之后晋升概率急剧下降，这形成了一个短暂的执法窗口期。利用断点回归设计，我们发现，由具备晋升资格的市长管辖的企业，其二氧化硫排放量的减少幅度显著大于同一市长在超过年龄门槛后的时期。这些减排效果主要集中在没有末端治理设备的企业中，并且是通过临时减少运营时间和产量实现的，而非技术升级。我们进一步记录到，在晋升窗口期内政府补贴有所增加，并且不成比例地流向那些削减生产的无设备企业，这与协调一致的短期合规行为相符。粗略估算表明，这些暂时性激励措施在“十一五”规划期间贡献了全国二氧化硫减排量的5.2%，但代价是工业总产出减少了0.9%。我们构建了一个企业合规的动态模型，显示此类短期激励会导致低效的基于产出的应对行为。我们的研究结果凸显了阶段性监管压力的局限性。

abstract: This study examines the industrial preferences of local governments in China through the lens of land allocation. We analyze industrial land transactions from 2007 to 2019, a period marked by both expanding industrial policy and intensifying land market competition. Using a border discontinuity design that compares land transactions near county borders, we separate local government preferences from firm demand. We find systematic industrial favoritism: localities offer deeper price discounts to industries aligned with their existing specialization. This favoritism persists over time, is more pronounced in industries with substantial unrealized agglomeration potential, and is stronger in regions with well-developed market institutions. We further show that local governments comply with upper-level industrial policy only when it aligns with their own specialization. Together, these findings point to a bottom-up process in which local governments use land allocation to attract firms that reinforce local industrial strengths through agglomeration spillovers.
abstract_zh: 本研究从土地配置的视角考察了中国地方政府的产业偏好。我们分析了2007年至2019年间的工业用地交易，这一时期既见证了产业政策的扩张，也伴随着土地市场竞争的加剧。通过采用边界断点设计，对县域边界附近的土地交易进行比较，我们将地方政府的偏好与企业需求分离开来。研究发现存在系统性的产业偏向：地方政府对与其现有专业化方向相符的产业给予更深的土地价格折扣。这种偏向随时间持续存在，在具有显著未实现集聚潜力的产业中更为突出，并且在市场制度发达的地区表现更强。我们进一步表明，地方政府仅在上级产业政策与其自身专业化方向一致时才予以执行。综合来看，这些发现揭示了一个自下而上的过程，即地方政府通过土地配置来吸引能够通过集聚溢出效应强化本地产业优势的企业。

abstract: We study a sequential screening model with discrete ex ante types and continuously distributed ex post values. The approach — solving a relaxed problem by pointwise maximization and focusing on deterministic cutoffs — relies on strong regularity conditions and can fail when they are violated. We develop an alternative method that retains local incentive constraints, allowing deterministic and stochastic mechanisms, and derive surplus-to-slack ratio tests that identify each case. We propose the weak alignment condition, a strengthening of first-order stochastic dominance that guarantees stochastic allocations respect global incentive constraints, and the strong alignment condition, under which the gap between deterministic and stochastic conditions closes. We extend the analysis to a continuum of types and solve for optimal mechanisms in the three-type case under additional shape restrictions on the surplus-to-slack ratios. Our results show that randomization can be essential and tractable in optimal dynamic mechanisms when regularity fails.
abstract_zh: 我们研究了一个序贯筛选模型，其中事前类型为离散分布，事后价值为连续分布。该方法——通过逐点最大化求解松弛问题并聚焦于确定性截断——依赖于强正则条件，当这些条件被违反时可能失效。我们开发了一种替代方法，保留局部激励约束，允许确定性和随机机制，并推导出盈余-松弛比检验，以识别每种情形。我们提出了弱对齐条件，这是对一阶随机占优的强化，确保随机分配尊重全局激励约束，以及强对齐条件，在该条件下，确定性与随机条件之间的差距得以闭合。我们将分析扩展到连续类型情形，并在对盈余-松弛比施加额外形状限制的情况下，求解了三类型案例中的最优机制。我们的结果表明，当正则性失效时，随机化在最优动态机制中可能是必要且可处理的。
title: Stochastic Sequential Screening
title_zh: 随机序贯筛选

abstract: We develop a verification theorem for infinite-horizon optimal stopping under G-Brownian motion and apply it to several stopping problems of economic interest. The theorem gives sufficient conditions under which a candidate solution to a system of variational inequalities is the value function under volatility, covariance, or joint drift–volatility ambiguity. In the canonical irreversible investment problem, volatility ambiguity advances investment because the worst-case scenario selects the lowest feasible volatility for a convex continuation value. Ambiguity about volatility therefore acts in the opposite direction from volatility itself, which postpones investment. In other environments, worst-case volatility can vary with the state, alter project relevance, create bilateral valuation wedges, shorten search, and change two-dimensional investment payoffs through covariance and correlation ambiguity. A common convexity-based mechanism drives these results: volatility ambiguity changes the perceived dispersion of future outcomes, whereas drift ambiguity acts through monotonicity.
abstract_zh: 我们针对G-布朗运动下的无限期最优停止问题建立了一个验证定理，并将其应用于若干具有经济意义的最优停止问题。该定理给出了充分条件，在这些条件下，变分不等式系统的候选解在波动率、协方差或联合漂移-波动率模糊性下即为价值函数。在经典不可逆投资问题中，波动率模糊性会提前投资，因为最坏情形选择对于凸的延续价值而言对应最低可行波动率。因此，关于波动率的模糊性其作用方向与波动率本身相反——后者会推迟投资。在其他环境中，最坏情形波动率可能随状态变化，改变项目的相关性，产生双边估值楔子，缩短搜寻时间，并通过协方差和相关性模糊性改变二维投资回报。一个基于凸性的共同机制驱动了这些结果：波动率模糊性改变了未来结果的感知离散度，而漂移模糊性则通过单调性发挥作用。
title: Optimal Stopping under Volatility Ambiguity
title_zh: 波动率模糊下的最优停止

abstract: A literature debates the explanations for the cyclical properties of emerging markets using either trend shocks Aguiar and Gopinath (2007) or financial frictions Garcia-Cicco et al. (2010); Neumeyer and Perri (2004). We state a formal proposition that makes explicit the parametric assumptions needed for consumption to behave (exactly) as in a random-walk, permanent income model. The result is general and applies to economies with endogenous investment and production. The proposition offers a fresh perspective on the debate regarding the sources of emerging market fluctuations, and reconciles diverging findings in the literature. Moreover, we quantitatively explore the business cycle properties of the RBC model when one moves away from the parametric assumptions suggested by the proposition.
abstract_zh: 关于新兴市场周期属性的解释，文献中存在两种观点：一种强调趋势冲击（Aguiar和Gopinath，2007），另一种则侧重于金融摩擦（Garcia-Cicco等，2010；Neumeyer和Perri，2004）。我们提出一个正式命题，明确阐述了使消费行为（精确地）符合随机游走、永久收入模型所需的参数假设。该结果具有普遍性，适用于包含内生投资和生产的经济体。这一命题为关于新兴市场波动来源的辩论提供了新视角，并调和了文献中的分歧发现。此外，我们定量探讨了当偏离命题所建议的参数假设时，RBC模型的商业周期特性。
title: When Is the Trend the Cycle?
title_zh: 趋势何时即周期？

abstract: The linear-in-means model is the standard empirical model of peer effects and asks that an agent’s choice or outcome is a combination of their ideal point and the mean outcome of their group. Using choice data and exogenous group variation, we develop a revealed preference style test for the linear-in-means model. This test is formulated as a linear program and can be interpreted as a condition about differentiating the behaviour of each agent in a consistent manner. We then study the identification properties of the linear-in-means model. A key takeaway from our analysis is the close relationship between the dimension of the outcome variable and identification. When the outcome variable is one-dimensional, failures of identification are generic. When the outcome variable is multidimensional, we provide natural conditions under which identification is generic.
abstract_zh: 线性均值模型是同伴效应的标准实证模型，它假设个体的选择或结果由其理想点与所在群体平均结果的组合构成。利用选择数据和外生群体变动，我们为线性均值模型开发了一种基于显示偏好的检验方法。该检验以线性规划形式表述，可被解释为对每个个体行为进行一致性区分的一种条件。随后，我们研究了线性均值模型的识别性质。我们分析的一个关键结论是结果变量维度与识别之间的紧密联系。当结果变量为一维时，识别失败是普遍存在的。当结果变量为多维时，我们提供了在自然条件下识别具有普遍性的充分条件。
title: Revealed Social Networks
title_zh: 揭示社会网络

abstract: In 2006, Amazon launched the Fulfilment by Amazon (FBA) program, providing support to third‐party sellers for a fee. While the program has the potential to enhance sellers' reputations, evidence regarding its effectiveness is limited. This study estimates the association between FBA usage and seller reputation, measured by the average star rating a seller receives. Using fixed effects and staggered difference‐in‐differences estimation approaches as well as 26 weeks of panel data from Canada, the United Kingdom and the United States, three key findings emerge. First, using FBA is significantly and positively associated with a seller's reputation, leading to higher average ratings in the short term than in the long term. This improvement is mainly due to FBA's competitive advantages, such as eligibility for Amazon Prime, standardised fulfilment quality and excellent customer service. Second, although the correlation between FBA and reputation is positive in every country, we find cross‐country heterogeneity in effect sizes and significance levels, with the largest effects in Canada. Third, we show that large sellers have the best reputation, and all sellers benefit from the FBA program. However, medium‐sized sellers benefit the most from the program. This trend can be attributed to how the benefits of the FBA program accrue optimally to sellers based on their operational scale. These results suggest that the FBA program is indeed effective in enhancing seller reputation, with implications for third‐party sellers, Amazon and regulators.
abstract_zh: 2006年年，亚马逊推出了亚马逊物流（FBA）计划，为第三方卖家提供有偿支持服务。尽管该计划有潜力提升卖家的声誉，但关于其有效性的证据仍然有限。本研究通过卖家获得的平均星级评分来衡量声誉，估计了使用FBA与卖家声誉之间的关联。利用固定效应和交错双重差分估计方法，以及来自加拿大、英国和美国的26周面板数据，我们得出了三个关键发现。第一，使用FBA与卖家声誉显著正相关，短期内平均评分提升幅度大于长期。这一改善主要归因于FBA的竞争优势，如符合亚马逊Prime资格、标准化的物流质量和卓越的客户服务。第二，尽管FBA与声誉之间的正相关在每个国家都存在，但我们发现效应大小和显著性水平存在跨国异质性，其中加拿大的效应最大。第三，我们表明大型卖家拥有最佳声誉，且所有卖家均从FBA计划中受益。然而，中型卖家从该计划中获益最多。这一趋势可归因于FBA计划的收益如何根据卖家的运营规模最优地累积。这些结果表明，FBA计划确实能有效提升卖家声誉，对第三方卖家、亚马逊及监管机构均具有启示意义。
title: Platform Fulfilment and Seller Reputation: Evidence From Amazon's Marketplace
title_zh: 平台履约与卖家声誉：来自亚马逊市场的证据

abstract: This article investigates the role of health perception biases for healthcare utilization and related expenditure in China, an underexplored context characterized by rapid population ageing and fragmented healthcare coverage. Using panel data on over 17,000 adults from the China Health and Retirement Longitudinal Study (CHARLS), we measure health perception biases as the difference between objective health outcomes from physical examinations and self-reported health. We find that health underestimation is associated with more doctor visits, while health overestimation is correlated with less doctor services. The positive association between underestimation and hospital stays is present in random-effects and correlated random-effects Poisson estimates but is not supported by the FE Poisson estimates. Health perception biases are also strongly associated with total and out-of-pocket expenditures for both outpatient and inpatient care. Importantly, family support – especially the presence of co-resident sons – moderates the association between health underestimation and doctor visits, highlighting the role of family dynamics in healthcare decisions. KEYWORDS: Health perception bias overconfidence underconfidence healthcare utilization China JEL CLASSIFICATION: I12 I18 P46
abstract_zh: 本文探讨了健康认知偏差在中国医疗保健利用及相关支出中的作用，这一背景尚未得到充分研究，其特点是人口快速老龄化和医疗保障覆盖碎片化。利用中国健康与养老追踪调查（CHARLS）中超过17，000名成年人的面板数据，我们将健康认知偏差量化为体检得出的客观健康结果与自报健康之间的差异。研究发现，健康低估与更多的就诊次数相关，而健康高估则与较少的医疗服务使用相关。低估与住院之间的正相关关系在随机效应和相关随机效应泊松估计中显著，但固定效应泊松估计未支持这一结果。健康认知偏差还与门诊和住院护理的总支出及自付支出密切相关。重要的是，家庭支持——尤其是与儿子同住——调节了健康低估与就诊次数之间的关联，凸显了家庭动态在医疗保健决策中的作用。关键词：健康认知偏差；过度自信；信心不足；医疗保健利用；中国 JEL分类：I12 I18 P46

abstract: We examine the impact of climate risk exposure on corporate resilience using data on Chinese A-share listed firms. The results show that higher climate-related disclosure intensity is significantly negatively associated with corporate resilience, with a stronger association among firms whose executives lack environmental backgrounds, as well as firms in high-carbon and heavily polluting industries. Further analysis indicates that greenwashing exacerbates this negative effect, whereas green investment effectively mitigates the adverse impact of climate risk on corporate resilience. Mechanism tests show that climate risk mainly undermines firms’ adaptive capacity by intensifying external monitoring and suppressing risk-taking. Overall, this article provides new disclosure-based evidence on the relationship between climate risk and corporate resilience. KEYWORDS: Climate risk corporate resilience external monitoring risk aversion textual analysis JEL CLASSIFICATION: Q54 L25 G32 D22
abstract_zh: 我们利用中国A股上市公司的数据，考察了气候风险暴露对企业韧性的影响。结果显示，气候相关披露强度越高，企业韧性显著越低，且这一关联在管理层缺乏环境背景的企业以及高碳、重污染行业的企业中更为明显。进一步分析表明，绿色洗白行为加剧了这一负面效应，而绿色投资则能有效缓解气候风险对企业韧性的不利影响。机制检验显示，气候风险主要通过加强外部监督和抑制风险承担来削弱企业的适应能力。总体而言，本文为气候风险与企业韧性之间的关系提供了基于披露的新证据。关键词：气候风险；企业韧性；外部监督；风险规避；文本分析 JEL分类：Q54 L25 G32 D22

abstract: Drawing on an unbalanced firm-year panel linking Chinese A-share listed firms to prefecture-level cities from 2012 to 2024, this study employs a staggered difference-in-differences (DID) framework to systematically estimate the effect of green data centre policy on corporate energy efficiency and to clarify the underlying mechanisms. The results show that the policy significantly enhances firms’ energy efficiency. Mechanism analyses suggest that the effect operates primarily through two channels: improved ESG performance and policy-induced increases in firms’ green investment. Heterogeneity analyses indicate that the policy impact is stronger in resource-based cities, in more competitive industries, and among mature-stage firms. Moderating analyses further show that executives’ digital cognition tends to weaken the policy effect when considered alone; however, when executives simultaneously exhibit high levels of both green and digital cognition, their synergistic alignment yields a positive moderating effect. In addition, as successive pilot batches expand, the policy’s diffusion effect exhibits a nonlinear trajectory, increasing initially and then declining thereafter. KEYWORDS: Green data centre policy corporate energy efficiency executives’ green cognition executives’ digital cognition JEL CLASSIFICATION: O21 O25
abstract_zh: 本研究基于2012至2024年间中国A股上市公司与地级市相匹配的不平衡企业-年度面板数据，采用交错双重差分（DID）框架，系统评估了绿色数据中心政策对企业能源效率的影响，并厘清了其内在作用机制。结果表明，该政策显著提升了企业能源效率。机制分析显示，这一效应主要通过两条渠道发挥作用：ESG表现的改善以及政策引致的企业绿色投资增加。异质性分析表明，政策效应在资源型城市、竞争更激烈的行业以及成熟期企业中更为显著。调节分析进一步显示，高管数字认知单独存在时倾向于削弱政策效应；然而，当高管同时具备高水平的绿色认知与数字认知时，二者的协同匹配产生了正向调节作用。此外，随着试点批次逐步扩展，政策的扩散效应呈现非线性轨迹，先上升后下降。关键词：绿色数据中心政策；企业能源效率；高管绿色认知；高管数字认知 JEL分类：O21 O25

title: Green data centre policy, executives’ cognition, and corporate energy efficiency

abstract: Corporate financialization has emerged as a pivotal force reshaping the finance–trade nexus and profoundly altering firms’ export trajectories. Using a panel of Chinese A-share non-financial listed firms from 2008 to 2024, this paper empirically examines the effect of corporate financialization on export scale and its underlying mechanisms. We find that financial asset accumulation significantly increases export volumes, and this result remains robust across a battery of sensitivity checks. Channel analyses reveal that the effect operates mainly through alleviating financing constraints and reducing information-acquisition costs. In addition, heterogeneity tests show that export performance is much stronger among firms located in regions with superior innovation environments, firms in industries with low competition, and firms with low technological intensity. The study provides micro-level evidence on the interlinkage between financial asset allocation and real economic activity, offering new insights into the finance-trade-growth chain. KEYWORDS: Corporate financialization firm-level exports financial asset allocation real economy activity
abstract_zh: 企业金融化已成为重塑金融—贸易关系并深刻改变企业出口轨迹的关键力量。利用2008年至2024年中国A股非金融类上市公司的面板数据，本文实证考察了企业金融化对出口规模的影响及其内在机制。研究发现，金融资产积累显著提升了出口规模，且这一结果在一系列敏感性检验中保持稳健。渠道分析表明，该效应主要通过缓解融资约束和降低信息获取成本发挥作用。此外，异质性检验显示，在创新环境优越地区的企业、低竞争行业中的企业以及技术密集度较低的企业中，出口表现更为突出。本研究为金融资产配置与实体经济活动之间的关联提供了微观层面的证据，为金融—贸易—增长链条提供了新的见解。关键词：企业金融化；企业层面出口；金融资产配置；实体经济活动

title: Does corporate financialization promote exports?
title_zh: 企业金融化是否促进了出口？

abstract: This book addresses Allan Sharlin's well-known thesis about the role of migration in early modern urban demography.Sharlin's original article, which was published in Past and Present in 1978, challenged traditional interpretations of the reasons for the slow growth of towns and cities in this period.The conventional view regarded these cities as 'urban graveyards' which only succeeded in sustaining themselves as a result of in-migration.Sharlin argued that the characterization of early modern cities as 'urban graveyards' was exaggerated and that their slow growth was actually caused by the barriers faced by temporary migrants in the marriage market.This meant that migrants faced the same mortality risks as the 'native' population without having the same opportunity to contribute to birth rates.In 1981, he responded to criticism of this argument by proposing a detailed analysis of the demographic history of the German city of Würzburg, but he died before he could undertake this.Jan de Vries was originally asked to take over responsibility for Sharlin's project but 'the rich data yielded by Sharlin's research design enabled the writing of a demographic analysis that comprehended his thesis but went beyond it' (p.xviii).This delayed completion of the project but led to the publication of this study.The book starts by providing a detailed account of Würzburg's history before giving an introduction to its records and the questions to which they lend themselves.These can be set out as follows: (1) how family demography varied by social class; (2) whether chronic high mortality in excess of fertility prevailed in Würzburg; (3) whether pre-industrial life generated a distinctive urban fertility regime; and (4) what role migration played in either supporting or limiting population growth.As De Vries explains, Würzburg was not necessarily an ideal test of Sharlin's original hypothesis.It was the Residenzstaat, or administrative capital, of the Prince-Bishopric of Würzburg.All rights reserved, including rights for text and data mining and training of artificial intelligence technologies or similar technologies.
title: Life, Death, and Migration in the Early Modern City: The Urban Historical Demography of WürzburgJandeVries, (Cambridge University Press, 2026. Pp. 304. ISBN 9781009641517. Hbk £95)
title_zh: 近代早期城市中的生、死与迁移：维尔茨堡的城市历史人口学研究

abstract: We study how insurer competition affects premiums for fully‐insured plans in the employer‐sponsored health insurance market. By utilizing quasi‐experimental variations induced by mergers among national insurers, we show that increased insurer concentration leads to higher premiums, but there exists substantial heterogeneity. In particular, we find that a increase in insurer concentration increases premiums for mid‐sized firms by but reduces premiums for large firms by . We explore additional sources of heterogeneity to shed light on the underlying mechanisms and conclude by discussing policy implications.
abstract_zh: 我们研究了保险公司竞争如何影响雇主提供的健康保险市场中全额保险计划的保费。利用全国性保险公司合并引发的准实验变异，我们发现保险公司集中度的提高导致保费上升，但存在显著的异质性。具体而言，我们观察到保险公司集中度的增加使中型企业的保费上升了，却使大型企业的保费下降了。我们进一步探索了异质性的其他来源以揭示潜在机制，并在结论中讨论了政策含义。
title: Distributional Effect of Insurer Competition on Premiums: Evidence From the Employer‐Sponsored Health Insurance Market
title_zh: 保险公司竞争对保费的分配效应：来自雇主赞助健康保险市场的证据

abstract: Professional sports offer rare field tests of game theory with observed choices, sharp incentives, and expert competitors. Ryder Cup Sunday singles is a simultaneous permutation game where captains order twelve players and pairings form slot by slot. Under Hurley (2002)’s benchmark, uniform random ordering is a mixed-strategy equilibrium of the constant-sum game, and therefore also a minimax strategy. Using Sunday singles orders from 1981–2025 and, where available, Data Golf and OWGR ranks before each Cup, I test whether within-team ability is assigned uniformly at random across lineup slots. Permutation tests reject uniform random assignment. The data indicate that stronger players appear earlier than random shuffles within teams predict, with the pattern more pronounced in later Ryder Cups.
abstract_zh: 职业体育为博弈论提供了罕见的实地检验场景，其中包含可观测的选择、明确的激励以及专家级竞争者。莱德杯周日单打赛是一种同时进行的排列博弈，队长们安排十二名球员出场顺序，配对逐位形成。在Hurley（2002）的基准框架下，均匀随机排序是该常和博弈中的混合策略均衡，因此也是极小化极大策略。利用1981年至2025年间的周日单打出场顺序，并在可获得的情况下结合每届杯赛前的Data Golf和OWGR排名，我检验了队内能力是否在各出场位次上被均匀随机分配。排列检验拒绝了均匀随机分配的假设。数据表明，较强球员在队内随机洗牌所预测的位次之前更早出场，且这一模式在后期的莱德杯中更为显著。
title: Do Ryder Cup captains randomize? Evidence from Sunday singles orders
title_zh: 莱德杯队长是否随机安排？来自周日单打顺序的证据

abstract: Multifunctional agriculture jointly produces commodity and non-commodity outputs, yet many non-commodity benefits are underprovided due to insufficient economic incentives. This challenge is amplified in the agriculture-tourism nexus, where tourism depends on agricultural landscapes while potentially contributing to their degradation, creating interconnected externalities that distort benefit distribution and undermine joint production efficiency. This study extends joint production theory to the agriculture-tourism nexus by developing a framework for integrated terraced agriculture-ecotourism production, in which tourism generates conservation incentives by capturing economic value from landscape and environmental services. We identify the socially optimal provision of agricultural non-commodity benefits under different landscape loss scenarios and examine how externality internalization and multi-stakeholder collaboration affect joint production efficiency. The results show that achieving optimal multifunctionality requires balancing the benefits and costs of externality internalization across agricultural and tourism activities. Failure to do so may reduce joint production efficiency by distorting factor income distribution. Multi-stakeholder collaboration improves benefit allocation and lowers internalization costs, enabling the socially optimal provision of agricultural non-commodity benefits. These findings underscore the need for integrated governance mechanisms that align economic incentives with ecological conservation in mountainous regions.
title: Joint production, externalities, and terrace conservation strategies
title_zh: 联合生产、外部性与梯田保护策略

abstract: While several different statistical methods have been employed to measure financial inclusion, two of the most frequently used in the literature are the adaptation of the Human Development Index (HDI) methodology proposed by Sarma (2008) and, more recently, the two-stage Principal Component Analysis (PCA) suggested by Cámara and Tuesta (2014). Employing a unique dataset on the access and usage of financial services across Mexican municipalities, this paper proposes the alternative use of two unsupervised Machine Learning (ML) methods: Nonnegative Matrix Factorization (NMF) and Kernel PCA (KPCA). To contrast the performance of the four different methods, we first cluster the municipalities using the K-Means algorithm. Thereafter, we focus our comparison of the indices produced by the four methods on the most financially excluded clusters, using standard ML performance metrics: precision, recall, F1 score, and accuracy. Our results show that both HDI and NMF significantly outperform PCA-based methods across different thresholds at the bottom of the distribution. Several robustness checks confirm our findings. This result is particularly significant, as poverty alleviation, one of the primary targets of financial inclusion, can only be achieved successfully if policymakers accurately identify individuals and regions that are excluded or underserved by the financial sector.
abstract_zh: 虽然已有多种统计方法用于衡量金融包容性，但文献中最常用的两种方法是Sarma（2008）提出的对人类发展指数（HDI）方法的改编，以及近期Cámara和Tuesta（2014）提出的两阶段主成分分析（PCA）。利用墨西哥各城市金融服务的获取和使用情况的独特数据集，本文提出采用两种无监督机器学习（ML）方法的替代方案：非负矩阵分解（NMF）和核主成分分析（KPCA）。为对比这四种方法的性能，我们首先使用K-Means算法对城市进行聚类。随后，我们将比较重点放在四种方法生成的指数上，针对金融排斥最严重的聚类，采用标准机器学习性能指标：精确率、召回率、F1分数和准确率。结果表明，在分布底部的不同阈值下，HDI和NMF均显著优于基于PCA的方法。多项稳健性检验证实了我们的发现。这一结果尤为重要，因为扶贫作为金融包容性的主要目标之一，只有在政策制定者准确识别被金融部门排斥或服务不足的个人和地区时，才能成功实现。
title: Enhancing financial inclusion measurements: A comparative analysis using unsupervised machine learning methods across Mexican municipalities
title_zh: 增强金融包容性测量：基于无监督机器学习方法的墨西哥各市镇比较分析

abstract: For its entire 15-year life as a regional bank until its collapse in 2023, Silicon Valley Bank held the same risky bet. This column argues that the risks were visible the whole time. The bank experienced rapid asset and stock price growth and maintained a high-risk profile with long-term securities funded by largely uninsured demand deposits. However, supervisors reacted only once unrecognised held-to-maturity losses materialised following the 2022-2023 interest rate increases. Thus, Silicon Valley Bank’s collapse is less a story of hidden danger than of a supervisory system that polices process rather than risk.
abstract_zh: 在其作为区域性银行长达15年的存续期内，直至2023年倒闭，硅谷银行始终持有同一高风险赌注。本文认为，这些风险自始至终显而易见。该银行经历了资产和股价的快速增长，并维持着高风险特征，以长期证券为主，资金主要来源于未投保的活期存款。然而，监管机构仅在2022-2023年利率上调后，未确认的持有至到期损失显现时才作出反应。因此，硅谷银行的倒闭与其说是隐藏风险的故事，不如说是监管体系侧重于过程监管而非风险监管的体现。
title: Anatomy of a supervisory failure
title_zh: 监管失败的剖析

abstract: Urban development frequently requires land assembly, cross-parcel coordination, and allocation of costs and benefits created by zoning plans. In Norway, property-formation tasks typically rely on cadastral procedures that depend on voluntary agreement and may involve multiple fragmented, sequential, and time-consuming approvals. This article examines whether organizational instruments under the Land Consolidation Act – rules on joint use, orders for joint measures, and governance arrangements – can function as a less invasive and more efficient complement to physical reallotment in urban land readjustment. Using a structured review of Norwegian zoning plans and Land Consolidation Court decisions, supplemented with targeted literature, we identify (i) coordination problems these instruments can address, (ii) their legal effects and constraints, and (iii) practical conditions for implementation, including loss-prevention rules and transition to later physical property formation. We conclude that organizational instruments are best suited for early-phase cooperation and shared functions (e.g., access, infrastructure, common areas), reducing transaction costs and holdout risks when physical reallotment is premature. We discuss implications for ‘fit-for-purpose’ land readjustment and outline how comparable rule-based joint-use solutions may be adapted to resource-constrained contexts, provided that legal clarity and registration mechanisms are addressed. In Norwegian land consolidation law traditional physical readjustment includes measures such as land exchange and the reduction of fragmentation of holdings. Organizational instruments, by contrast, operate closer to the actual coordination problems faced in urban development. As such, they represent a more fit-for-purpose response to the challenges of fragmented ownership and cross-boundary planning in transformation areas.
abstract_zh: 城市发展常常需要土地整合、跨地块协调以及分区规划所产生成本与收益的分配。在挪威，土地形成任务通常依赖于地籍程序，这些程序以自愿协议为基础，并可能涉及多个分散、连续且耗时的审批环节。本文考察《土地整理法》下的组织性工具——关于共同使用的规则、共同措施的命令以及治理安排——是否能够在城市土地调整中，作为物理性重新分配的一种侵入性更小、效率更高的补充手段。通过对挪威分区规划和土地整理法院裁决的结构化审查，辅以针对性文献，我们识别出（i）这些工具能够解决的协调问题，（ii）其法律效力与限制，以及（iii）实施的实际条件，包括损失预防规则和向后续物理性土地形成的过渡。我们得出结论：组织性工具最适合于早期阶段的合作和共享功能（如通道、基础设施、公共区域），在物理性重新分配尚不成熟时，能够降低交易成本和持有风险。我们讨论了其对“因地制宜”土地调整的启示，并概述了在资源受限情境下，如何调整类似的基于规则的共同使用解决方案，前提是法律明确性和登记机制得到解决。在挪威土地整理法中，传统的物理性调整包括土地交换和减少地块碎片化等措施。相比之下，组织性工具更贴近城市发展中所面临的实际协调问题。因此，它们代表了对转型区域中碎片化所有权和跨边界规划挑战的一种更符合实际需求的回应。
title: Rethinking land readjustment: Fit-for-purpose rules for joint use in real estate development
title_zh: 重新思考土地整理：面向房地产开发联合使用的适用性规则

abstract: Dynamic complementarity is the concept that past investments that lead to higher stocks of skill at one age promote the growth of skills from investment at that age. We define and provide evidence on dynamic complementarity using unique Chinese data from a home visiting program for young children targeted to parents in rural China. In addition, we investigate growth in learning due to innate, parental, and environmental factors that occur in the absence of any formal intervention.
abstract_zh: 动态互补性是指过去投资导致某一年龄段技能存量增加，进而促进该年龄段投资所带来技能增长的概念。我们利用中国农村地区针对幼儿家长的家访项目的独特数据，定义并提供了动态互补性的证据。此外，我们还考察了在没有正式干预的情况下，由先天、父母及环境因素引起的学习增长情况。
china_relevance_reason: 标题、摘要或元数据包含中国相关关键词
title: Dynamic Complementarity
title_zh: 动态互补性

abstract: We study how outside options affect workers’ incentives to exert effort. We exploit quasiexperimental variation from age- and experience-based cutoffs in Austria’s unemployment insurance (UI), and proxy effort with absenteeism. Extending potential UI benefit duration increases absenteeism, with larger effects for workers facing higher unemployment risk, those employed at declining or low-wage firms, or those on flatter wage profiles. These results are consistent with a relational contracting model where effort reductions caused by higher outside options are more pronounced if the perceived relationship value is small.
abstract_zh: 我们研究外部选择如何影响工人付出努力的激励。我们利用奥地利失业保险中基于年龄和经验的临界点所产生的准实验变异，并以缺勤作为努力程度的代理指标。延长潜在失业保险金领取期限会增加缺勤现象，且对于面临更高失业风险、就职于衰退或低工资企业、或处于更平缓工资曲线的工人，其影响更为显著。这些结果与关系契约模型一致，在该模型中，当感知到的关系价值较小时，由更高外部选择导致的努力减少更为明显。
title: Outside Options and Worker Effort
title_zh: 外部选择与员工努力

abstract: Although research has shown that court-ordered hiring quotas increase the number of minority police officers in litigated cities, there has been little insight into how workforce diversity, or lack thereof, may impact police violence against civilians. Using an event study framework, we find that the threat of affirmative action litigation reduces police killings of non-White civilians in the long-run. In addition, we find evidence of lower arrest rates for non-White civilians and more diverse police departments 25 years after litigation. Our results highlight the vital role that federal interventions have in addressing police behavior and the use of lethal force.
title: The Impact of Affirmative Action Litigation On Police Killings of Civilians
title_zh: 肯定性行动诉讼对警察杀害平民事件的影响

abstract: How should monetary policy respond to sectoral shocks in a world where consumption baskets vary systematically across households? We present a multi-sector New-Keynesian model with generalized, non-homothetic preferences and inequality. The output gap is governed by a Marginal Consumer Price Index (MCPI), rather than the regular CPI. Policy trade-offs are shaped by a novel wedge in the New-Keynesian Phillips Curve (NKPC). Analytical results and quantitative simulations show that, following negative shocks to necessity sectors, the NKPC is shifted upward, increasing CPI inflation but decreasing the output gap. We find that the optimal policy response is relatively accommodative.
title: Optimal Monetary Policy during a Cost-of-Living Crisis
title_zh: 生活成本危机期间的最优货币政策

abstract: This paper explores how to reduce emissions from electricity generation while preventing blackouts. Wind and solar are zero-emissions but intermittent, which can lead to blackouts if the entry of renewables causes more reliable power plants to retire. I build a structural dynamic oligopoly model of investment in generators of different energy sources. Using data from Western Australia, I show that a combination of carbon taxes and capacity subsidies substantially reduces emissions while keeping reliable generators from retiring, thereby maintaining a low risk of blackouts. I also explore the impact of renewable subsidies and storage.
title: Investment, Emissions, and Reliability in Electricity Markets
title_zh: 电力市场中的投资、排放与可靠性

abstract: We evaluate the validity of commonly used hospital quality indicators using hospital closures that reallocate large numbers of patients to hospitals of different quality. Using over 20 years of Medicare claims for over 30 million patients admitted with five common diagnoses, we find that hospital quality indicators overstate the causal impact of hospitals on mortality and readmission rates by less than 10% but overstate hospital impacts on inpatient cost and length of stay by closer to 40%. On average, hospital closures reduce patient mortality by shifting patients to higher quality hospitals, but the effect varies widely.
title: Validating Hospital Quality Indicators and the Causal Effect of Hospital Closures
title_zh: 验证医院质量指标与医院关闭的因果效应

abstract: Secondary markets for sovereign bonds are illiquid because of trad- ing frictions. I build a framework with endogenous illiquidity to study its implications on credit spreads and default risk. The model integrates directed search in secondary markets into a sovereign de- fault model. With trading frictions, secondary market demand and supply flows are important drivers of bond prices, while they are irrelevant in standard sovereign default models. I find that small trading frictions can significantly tighten a government's financial constraint and that policy interventions that reduce the sell flows in the secondary markets can partially revert the effect of trading frictions.
title: Sovereign Debt, Default Risk, and the Liquidity of Government Bonds
title_zh: 主权债务、违约风险与政府债券流动性

abstract: This paper analyzes the strategic interactions between a profit-maximizing monopolist and a free, capacity-constrained public option. By restricting its own supply, the monopolist intentionally congests the public option and induces rationing, which increases consumers’ willingness to pay for guaranteed access. Counterintuitively, expanding the public option’s capacity may raise the monopoly price and lower consumer welfare. I derive conditions under which all buyer types benefit from a capacity expansion, and extend these results to a setting where an oligopoly competes with a public option. These findings have implications for mixed publicprivate markets, such as housing, education, and healthcare.
title: Luck Out or Outpay? Competing with a Public Option
title_zh: 侥幸胜出还是付出更多？与公共选项竞争
